text:
Alex: FYI — our GPU Savings Plan / RI renewal window opens in ~3 weeks for us-west-2 + eu-west-1. Thinking we should decide buy-now vs staggered. us-west is steady, eu-west is spiky. :thinking:
Priya: quick data: last 90d utilization of reserved capacity: us-west-2 = 84% (A100 baseline), eu-west-1 = 49% (mostly burst). On-demand % for eu-west up ~35% of GPU hours.
FinanceBot: automated summary: total current commit $48,200/mo; effective price per A100-hour = $3.12 vs on-demand $4.30 (≈27.5% savings). Unused commit (eu-west) cost ~ $6.1k/mo last 30d.
Jamal: reminder: H100 migration plan for inference nodes hitting prod in ~4-6 months. If we lock heavy A100 commitments now we risk mismatch. Convertible RIs/Savings Plans give some flexibility, but review exchange terms.
Mariana: infra notes: we have autoscale + burst pools in eu-west that already fallback to on-demand. For latency-sensitive endpoints we keep us-west pinned. Proposal: reserve baseline capacity in us-west for steady traffic, keep eu-west mostly on-demand until after H100 rollouts.
Alex: concrete numbers would help. What does baseline look like?
Priya: baseline estimate: us-west steady = ~10 A100-equivalent GPUs (24/7), eu-west baseline = ~2 A100-equivalent. Peaks in eu-west are handled by burst pool (~+6 GPUs) ~20% of hours. So recommend committing for ~12 A100-equivalents total but weight 10 to us-west, 2 to eu-west.
Jamal: question on product constraints — can we map Savings Plan to specific instance families/regions? AWS SPs are more flexible across regions/instance families if you choose Compute SP, but RIs are regional. Might prefer Compute Savings Plan vs regional RI for flexibility.
Mariana: ops caveat — compute SP covers instance family but still exposes risk if we move to H100 (different family/sku). If we plan to migrate workloads to H100, the SP will cover some but not all. Another approach: split buy: commit 70% of predicted baseline now as SP, leave 30% uncommitted for migration.
Alex: cost delta if we only commit 70% now? Priya?
Priya: rough calc (monthly): current commit $48.2k for 100% baseline. If we commit 70% baseline => $33.7k/mo. On-demand top-up cost estimate for remaining 30% = ~$7.6k/mo (based on current OD price). Net spend ≈ $41.3k/mo vs $48.2k current (saves ~$6.9k/mo) and preserves headroom for H100. Break-even on migrating to H100 depends on price difference; see separate calc.
FinanceBot: note: cloud rep discount tiers kick in at >$60k/mo committed; we are under that. Consider negotiating exchange clauses instead of larger commit.
Jamal: +1 to negotiating. Also check reserved instance marketplace/transfer options for A100->H100 later.
Mariana: operational plan: if we go 70% SP now - infra will tag committed instances and add autoscale policy to prefer reserved pool. We'll add monitoring alert for commit utilization dropping below 65% for two weeks.
Alex: timeline suggestion: 1) decide split (70% SP + 30% OD) this week, 2) ask finance to try to negotiate exchange with cloud rep, 3) revisit after H100 pilot (90 days). Anyone object?
Priya: fine with that. I'll prepare a short cost sheet and PR to the cloud finance ticket.
Jamal: I'll loop in cloud rep and check convertible options / exchange rules.
Mariana: I'll prepare infra changes and the alert.
Alex: OK — action items: @Priya create cost calc + PR, @Jamal contact rep, @Mariana infra tasks + alert, @FinanceBot re-run numbers after updates. We'll reconvene in 7 days or sooner if rep gives options. :thumbsup:
FinanceBot: logged action: savingsplan-decision-1773501123, assigned to Priya/Jamal/Mariana, review date 1773770000.
